name: Takayama (Gunma, Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Takayama village emblem in white: a crown-like device above a broken ring.
history: Municipal flag of Takayama, a village in Gunma Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 10 February 1971.

features.role: Takayama village emblem — a crown-like device above a broken ring
